articles.summary: "Poster" dunks, or slam dunks over a contesting defender, are some of the most electric sequences in basketball. Watch the most explosive "poster" dunks in recent March Madness history.

articles.title: March Madness moments with zero context
articles.summary: Enjoy recent funny moments in March Madness history, but without any context. Watch some of the most memorable NCAA basketball tournament moments from interviews, fans, highlights, and more.

articles.title: Florida leads Andy Katz's men's basketball Power 44 rankings ahead of the 2026-27 season
articles.summary: With the NCAA tournament field expanding from 68 to 76 teams beginning with the 2026-27 season, Andy Katz has expanded his weekly power rankings from 37 to 44. Check out his latest rankings just weeks before the men's college basketball season tips off.

articles.title: 50 minutes of '70s March Madness men's highlights that'll leave you feeling nostalgic
articles.summary: Watch some of the best moments, finishes, and players from 1970s March Madness, including Earvin "Magic" Johnson, Larry Bird, Bill Walton, Austin Carr, Pete Maravich, Jack Givens, UCLA's seven straight titles (four straight from the 1970s), and more.

articles.title: Slam dunks from men's college basketball players, by different heights
articles.summary: Watch March Madness dunks from over the years, featuring players ranging from 5'11" to 7'9" in height.

articles.title: Hysterical March Madness press conference moments that'll keep you laughing
articles.summary: Enjoy some of the most memorable funny moments from recent March Madness men's press conferences, featuring college basketball personalities like Dan Hurley, John Calipari, Roy Williams, and Nigel Hayes.

articles.title: 54 minutes of 2000s March Madness highlights that'll leave you feeling nostalgic
articles.summary: Watch some of the best moments, finishes, and players from 2000s March Madness, including NBA legends like Carmelo Anthony, Chris Paul and Steph Curry.

articles.title: Every time a 15-seed has upset a 2-seed in March Madness history
articles.summary: Relive every 15-over-2 seed upset in March Madness men's basketball tournament history. From Richmond's historic upset of Syracuse in 1991 to a three-year stretch of 15-over-2 shockers, watch all of these unforgettable NCAA tournament upsets.

articles.title: 6 current NCAA student-athletes on USA Basketball at the 2026 FIBA 3x3 U23 World Cup
articles.summary: The FIBA 3x3 U23 World Cup is here. Lets meet your 2026 USA Basketball FIBA 3x3 U23 World Cup men's and women's rosters.

articles.title: 10 minutes of 'surrender cobra' moments in March Madness history
articles.summary: The "surrender cobra" is an involuntary gesture of anguished defeat or shock, with hands clasped on top of or behind the head. Watch these "surrender cobra" moments featuring some of the craziest sequences, events, and upsets in March Madness history.

articles.summary: Here is how participants in the Opening Round have done since 2011 — and why you should consider picking one in your NCAA bracket.
